title: Llevar + Gerund: How Long Something Has Been Going On
goal: Say how long something has been going on with llevar, a length of time and a gerund.

sections.title: Can you do this?
items: I can say how long something has been going on with llevar, a length of time and a gerund.
I can say how long I have gone without doing something with llevar sin and an infinitive.
I can use the new words for queues, building work and long efforts.
